title: oSzoukaua's: RTeaP
description: This mod adds a simple diegetic way to RTP(Random teleport) in-game without commands!
body:
# Description: This mod adds a few new items, and a new fluid. The primary item of focus is the "Bucka' R-Tea" which will RTP the player once consumed (with a configurable distance and cooldown)
Items and recipes **Mod items added:** R-Tea fluid - Chorus fruit effect when stood in for long enough, will turn cookies to soggy cookies on contact
![R-Tea fluid recipie](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/54e0dbdadf48d8512ebdd1a7537e5cf7b83b08f3.png)

Bukka' R-Tea - Will RTP the player once consumed
![Bucka' R-Tea recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a88c4255fb115c65ad7a88852f02a8662d647ee3.png)

Botto' R-Tea - RTPs the player around their current location at a much smaller scale, 1000 blocks standard, configurable
![Botto' R-Tea recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d936a5322621c4de4f935647fa8f2489829647f.png)
Soggy cookie - Acts as chorus fruit when consumed
Technical Notes ## Technical Notes:
The config file is named rtea_config.toml and located in the standard mod config location

It will allow you to modify:

**apply_cooldown_in_creative** - Apply item cooldown when consumed in creative mode (Default: false)

**consume_bucket_in_creative** - Consume the Bukka rteap when consumed in creative mode (Default: false)

**global_cooldown** - Trigger item cooldowns for both Buckets and bottles when either are consumed (Default: true)

**rtp_when_in_fluid** - RTP the player when they are within the fluid for the set duration (Default: true)

**fluid_rtp_timer** - Time in ticks to count before the RTP of the player (Default: 100)

**fluid_rtp_distance** - Distance to RTP the player when fluid RTP ticks down (Default: 16)

**bucket_rtp_cooldown** - Cooldown for using RTP bucket (Default: 6000)

**bucket_rtp_distance** - Distance to RTP the player when drinking from RTP Bucket (Default: 29999900)

**bottle_rtp_cooldown** - Cooldown for using RTP bottle (Default: 1200)

**bottle_rtp_distance** - Distance to RTP the player when drinking from RTP bottle (Default: 1000)
